releaseBoundary: This is a manually pinned primary-source security baseline. It is not a live updater. Refresh checkedAt, versions, securityFixCount and reference on the day of every public Direct release. A zero securityFixCount means the official Stable post did not enumerate security fixes; it never means that the version is exempt from the minimum-version gate.
policy: New public NeAntik Direct builds must meet the latest widely deployed macOS Desktop Stable security baseline. The official October13 update lists155.0.8059.79/.80 and37 security fixes. M156 Early Stable remains a limited rollout, tracked separately. Refresh on publication day; historical provenance binds archived baseline bytes independently.
